theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.

top_news.title: UniSuper CIO Is Not A Skeptic on AI
top_news.summary: In a rare BTV interview, John Pearce, Chief Investment Officer of Unisuper says AI industry is closer to the top of the super cycle. In a conversation with Bloomberg's Haidi Stroud-Watts, he talks about what makes some AI business models dodgy and the risks in the space. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Braskem Creditor Bracebridge Starts Involuntary Chapter 11
top_news.summary: Three funds affiliated with Bracebridge Capital have filed an involuntary petition for a Chapter 11 against a Braskem SA entity they lent to.

top_news.title: MSCI Pressed by Investors to Justify Drastic Indonesia Warning
top_news.summary: As MSCI Inc. officials joined a call on Tuesday afternoon Jakarta time, many of the more than 100 participants were investors still reeling from the index provider’s sudden warning of a potential double downgrade for Indonesia. They questioned the need for such a drastic step and wanted to know whether the country stood a chance of retaining its emerging-market status.

top_news.title: Citi Targets Top Spot in China as It Awaits Securities License
top_news.summary: Citigroup Inc. is counting on securing an onshore securities license in China as the US lender expands operations in the world’s second-largest economy following a string of major consumer exits across Asia.

top_news.title: Eight Months of War Turns China Petrochemical Glut Into a Crunch
top_news.summary: China has burned through much of a petrochemicals glut built up by years of overproduction as the US-Iran war chokes oil flows, setting the stage for higher prices for an array of industrial materials.

top_news.title: ASX to Unveil New Strategy in 2027 as CEO Attia Lays Out Roadmap
top_news.summary: ASX Ltd. is planning to unveil more details of its strategic transformation in the first half of next year, as the embattled bourse seeks to execute a turnaround.

top_news.title: APA to Build Major Australia Gas Pipeline to Avert Shortfalls
top_news.summary: APA Group reached a final investment decision on a natural gas pipeline between Queensland and New South Wales states, which could help alleviate projected shortfalls in the more heavily populated southeast of Australia.

top_news.title: US Orders Some Diplomats Out of Saudi Arabia Amid Houthi Attacks
top_news.summary: The US State Department issued an ordered departure for non-emergency personnel and their families from Saudi Arabia because of the growing threat from Houthi militants in neighboring Yemen.

top_news.title: EQT Reaches €9.6 Billion Deal for Molecular Testing Firm Qiagen
top_news.summary: EQT AB has agreed to acquire Qiagen NV for around €9.6 billion ($10.8 billion), bringing an end to years of takeover speculation involving the European molecular testing company.
